outcome.interpretation: Three exact Compiler regression report references are now readable as bounded derived observations. Their recorded cache stages and output-equivalence fields are exposed, but no verified source_session_context links them to an originating Compiler objective. The Environment reader's related_work is not source attribution and is not used as a substitute. The projection remains partial because this is a bounded historical page and the response was truncated; the five selected references themselves verified with no unavailable records.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Verified Compiler regression stages are detached from their originating objective in the environmental projection
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability-intelligence projection and Compiler regression evidence capture
pressure_hypothesis.basis: On one selected evidence page, three distinct content-addressed Compiler regression reports were adapted and their recorded stage details became visible. None matched a verified supporting observation with explicit source_session_context. The current Environment reader's campaign and work intent are known, but cannot establish which Compiler session or objective produced those reports.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: observed in three report records on one bounded campaign page; cross-session recurrence not established
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve the current read-only report access and make future Compiler evidence joinable through an explicit, authenticated source-context observation tied to the exact repository, commit, path, identity, and digest. Until such evidence exists, retain source-session attribution as unavailable.
